Domicile certificate (for MP candidates) Frequently Asked Questions Admission Courses College Facilities Bihar Credit Card Q. What are the eligibility criteria for B.Tech admission? Answer For admission in B. Tech, students must have passed 10+2 or equivalent exam in Science Stream (PCM/PCB) from a Recognized Board/Council/University either State or National or International. The minimum aggregate marks should be 50% in the case of General and 45% in the case of SC/ST/OBC. Q. Are XII pass-out students from the NIOS board and Bihar Open Board eligible for admission in B.Tech.? Answer Yes, all educational boards are accepted for admission in B. Tech. as long as they are recognized by the Government of India. Q. On which basis can I apply for admission to B.Tech? Answer Students can apply for admission to B. Tech. based on the following: JEE Mains - for 1st-year admission based on JEE Score 2025 Qualifying Exam Based - for 1st-year admission based on (10+2) result Note: JEE Score will be given priority when compared to the 12th result Q. How many rounds are there in MP DTE 2025 counseling? Answer There are two major rounds in MP DTE 2025 counselling. Round 1 – Based on JEE Score Round 2 – Based on JEE Score (for seats left blank after 1st round) Once these two rounds finish, students can go for College Level Counseling (CLC) for the admission process. Q. Is it necessary to register first in MP DTE Counselling to get admitted to college? Answer Yes it is very much necessary to register first in MP DTE Counseling to gain admission to college Q. What are the percentage criteria for admission to college? Answer The student must have passed his 12th exam in Science Stream from a recognized Board/University/Council with a minimum of 50% score for general candidates and a minimum of 45% score in the case of SC/ST/OBC candidates. Q. What is the best method to take admission in college? Answer The best and proper method while taking admission in a college is to visit the college campus personally and take active notes on the workings of the institute. Necessary questions about attendance, lab workings, and curriculum should also be asked. Meeting with the department and college head should also be done as a precautionary measure. Q. What is the accreditation status of Sagar Group of Institutions-SISTec? Answer Sagar Group of Institutions-SISTec is accredited by NAAC (National Assessment and Accreditation Council). Additionally, the departments of Computer Science & Engineering; Electrical & Electronics Engineering; Electronics & Communication Engineering; and Mechanical Engineering are accredited by the NBA (National Board of Accreditation). Q. Can students apply online to Sagar Group of Institutions-SISTec for the admission procedure? Answer Yes, students can apply online in Sagar Group of Institutions-SISTec for the admission process. Q. What are the documents required for the admission procedure in SISTec? Answer The list of documents required for the admission process at SISTec are (original and two self-attested copies): JEE Mains 2025 scorecard 10th mark sheet and passing certificate 12th mark sheet and passing certificate Migration Certificate, Transfer Certificate, and Character Certificate Caste Certificate (if applicable) Gap Certificate (if applicable) Income Certificate (if applicable) Aadhar Card or any other recognized ID proof 3 passport size photographs Q. Is the physical presence of a candidate compulsory at the time of reporting of allotment of college? Answer Yes, physical presence is required during the allotment process. Q. What is the fee structure? Answer The fee structure is decided by the Government of Madhya Pradesh (MP) through the Admission & Fee Regulatory Committee (AFRC). All fee-related details are available at http://www.afrcmp.org However, there are certain concessions a student can avail, that are granted by the institution at its discretion. For further details about that, one can contact and schedule a visit to our campus. Contact Us Q. What are the fee payment options available? Answer The fee is to be paid online through ERP in the College’s Bank Account. Q. What is the fee payment schedule? Answer The fee is to be paid semester-wise, i.e. two times each year, the dates for which are predefined by the institute. (20th June and 20th November) Q. Does SISTec help in getting an education loan? Answer No, the institute does not directly help in getting education loans, however, all the documents required for availing loans are provided by the institute without any hassle. Q. Can I directly come to college for admission without registering online? Answer Yes, one can directly come to the college for the admission process, the management will help and guide you through the whole admission procedure. However, online registration is compulsory and one will not be able to get an admission without registering online first. The college will help with that too. Q. Are parents required at the college during the admission process? Answer Parents don't need to accompany the student during the admission procedure. However, the presence of parents/guardians along with the student is advisable as they also get an idea about the institute and its methodologies. Q. Will a good score in my school result have a positive impact on my admission? Answer If a student scores 90%+ in their 12th exam, they will be entitled to certain benefits and privileges, for more details about them, one can contact and schedule a visit at our campus. Contact Us Q. Do the original documents need to be submitted during admission? Answer Only Transfer Certificate (TC) and Migration Certificate need to be submitted once admission is finalized. Rest all documents need not be submitted. They are just required for verification purposes and are returned instantly. Q. Can admission be canceled? Answer Yes the admission can be canceled, for a detailed process about it visit the DTE MP website. Q. What all courses are offered at Sagar Group of Institutions - SISTec? Answer Sagar Group of Institutions - SISTec offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in Engineering, Pharmacy, and Management namely Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech.), Master of Technology (M. Tech.), Bachelor of Pharmacy (B. Pharm.), Master of Pharmacy (M. Pharm.), Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), and Master of Business Administration (MBA). Q. What is the seat matrix of Sagar Group of Institutions - SISTec? Answer Seat matrix of SISTec: Civil Engineering - 150 Computer Science & Engineering - 420 Computer Science & Information Technology - 60 CSE with Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - 60 CSE with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - 120 CSE with Internet of Things - 60 CSE with Cyber Security - 60 Electrical Engineering - 90 Electrical & Electronics Engineering - 60 Electronics & Communication Engineering - 180 Mechanical Engineering - 240 Q. Sagar Group of Institutions-SISTec is affiliated with which University? Answer SISTec is affiliated to Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya (RGPV) for Engineering and Pharmacy courses and affiliated to Barkatullah University (BU Bhopal) for Management courses. Q. What different branches are available at SISTec? Answer SISTec offers engineering programs (B. Tech.) in the following branches: Civil Engineering Computer Science & Engineering Computer Science & Information Technology CSE with Artificial Intelligence and Data Science CSE with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning CSE with Internet of Things CSE with Cyber Security Electrical Engineering Electrical & Electronics Engineering Electronics & Communication Engineering Mechanical Engineering Q. Which branch is good? Answer There is no good or bad in any branch. Each branch has its own merits and requirements in the industry. It is up to the skill, talent, and passion of a student that makes a branch successful. Q. What is SGI and how many colleges are there in Sagar Group of Institutions? Answer Sagar Group of Institutions® or SGI is the educational wing of the Sagar Group that comprises: A.) Three Engineering Colleges: Sagar Institute of Science and Technology (SISTec) Sagar Institute of Science Technology and Research (SISTec-R) Sagar Institute of Science Technology and Engineering (SISTec-E) B.) Two Pharmacy Institutes: Sagar Institute of Pharmacy and Technology (SIPTec) Sagar Institute of Pharmaceutical Technology and Research (SIPTec-R) C.) One Business School: SISTec Business School Q. About Sagar Group? Answer Sagar Group, the parent company of SISTec is one of the largest corporate houses and business conglomerates in Central India. The group over the years has become a proven name in the fields of real estate, education, production manufacturing, and healthcare. To know more about The Group and its ventures visit The Sagar Q. How is the placement scenario of Sagar Group of Institutions – SISTec? Answer The Training and Placement Cell is well connected with the best of industries and generates great opportunities for its students. The training commences from 1st Year itself. For further details visit our Training & Placement Page Q. Is there any dress code in Sagar Group of Institutions – SISTec Answer No, there is no dress code at SISTec, but students are advised to wear decent and classy outfits. Q. Is there a hostel facility in SISTec for both boys and girls? Answer Yes, the college does provide hostel facilities for both boys and girls (separate buildings) within the college campus. There is also a mess facility available which is run by the college administration both for hostellers and day-scholars. Q.
